edition.authority: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments, with approval of Pope John Paul II
edition.notes: The authority state and physical issue date are kept distinct. John Paul II approved the restored rite on 1 October 1998; decree Prot. 1280/98/L promulgated it on 22 November 1998; the official notification dated 27 January 1999 states that the Latin edition had appeared the preceding day. The official Notitiae issue reproduces the decree and the book's proemium and praenotanda, not the complete ritual book.
edition.title: De Exorcismis et Supplicationibus Quibusdam, editio typica

passages.context: Printed p. 138 directly identifies the restored Roman Ritual title as De Exorcismis et Supplicationibus Quibusdam and labels it Editio typica. It controls edition identity and the start of the proemium, not formulas or the complete book.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but it contains modern editorial, typographic, liturgical, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: Postconciliar Roman Ritual title approved on 1 October 1998, promulgated by decree dated 22 November 1998, physically issued in Latin on 26 January 1999, and reprinted with technical-typographical corrections as an emended typical edition in 2004.
